start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter padhenge. Aapko rectangles ya squares mein se kya zyada pasand hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunkar lagta hai aap bahut akela mehsoos kar rahe hain. Kya aap abhi okay hain?
Theek hai Kabir, perimeter ko boundary ke chakkar jaisa sochiye—vegetable patch par fencing karni ho toh poori boundary naapenge. Aap kya pick karenge?

turns.line: rectangle ke chaaron sides jodenge, 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, 160 metre
turns.reply: Bilkul, aapne rectangle ki chaaron sides jodi: 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30 equals 160 metre. Polygon mein bhi sab sides jodiye; square ki sides kaise jodenge?
